name: mordred-fated-luminary-graveyard-attack-card-never-floats-for-memory-cost
notes: Mordred, Fated Luminary (KqBosnU7pU): "Attack cards in your graveyard have floating memory and 'Ephemerate -- (X)'." (While paying a memory cost you may banish a card with floating memory from your graveyard to pay for 1 of that cost.) ENGINE BUG (found, confirmed live, NOT fixed): HasFloatingMemory() (Custom/GameLogic.php) grants the Fated Luminary floating memory only when isset($obj->Controller) -- but a graveyard object has no persisted Controller (the Graveyard zone class serializes only CardID; it carries just PlayerID), so every graveyard card parsed back from the game state fails the check. The champion is Fated Luminary, the graveyard holds a Striking Tides (an attack card) and the two seeded memory cards are one short of the memory cost 3 of the same-level level-up into Aurelian Regent, which the floating Striking Tides should make up: instead GetMaterializeFloatingChoices() is empty, the payment check fails ("Cannot pay costs for the selected material card. Action undone.") and the champion stays Fated Luminary. The REGRESSION GUARD assertions pin that outcome (the Ephemerate half of the card, which passes the player explicitly, works: see mordred-fated-luminary-ephemerate-attack-card-from-graveyard).

rulesClauses: Attack cards in your graveyard have floating memory (a floating card pays 1 of a memory cost).

engineBug.summary: Fated Luminary's floating-memory grant never applies to graveyard cards parsed back from the game state. HasFloatingMemory() (Custom/GameLogic.php) grants it only when isset($obj->Controller), but the Graveyard zone class serializes only CardID and carries just PlayerID, so a reloaded graveyard object has no Controller. Confirmed live with direct engine calls on the fixture state: the seeded graveyard Striking Tides reports Controller = NULL, HasFloatingMemory() = false, MordredFatedEphemerateApplies(1, id) = true, GetMaterializeFloatingChoices(1) = '' and ZoneSearch('myGraveyard', floatingMemoryOnly:true) = []; the level-up into Aurelian Regent then fails the payment check ('Cannot pay costs for the selected material card. Action undone.').
engineBug.affectedFunction: Custom/GameLogic.php HasFloatingMemory() (Mordred, Fated Luminary branch gated on isset($obj->Controller)); GraveyardZone objects have only PlayerID
engineBug.verification: Root cause confirmed live with direct engine calls on the fixture state (Controller=NULL, HasFloatingMemory=false, GetMaterializeFloatingChoices='' while MordredFatedEphemerateApplies=true). Break/restore: using ($obj->Controller ?? $obj->PlayerID) in HasFloatingMemory() flipped this guard red (the floating payment prompt is now offered, so the flash message and refusal disappear); restored, shasums verified.
